detected.title: Detected apps
persistent.confirmBodyWindows:
{0} will start with its local connection enabled from now on.

This edits {1} shortcut(s) you launch it from. The connection is local to this PC only.

After this you will not have to close and reopen {0} again. The session open right now still needs one last relaunch.

Set this up?
persistent.confirmBodyMac:
A login item will start {0} with its local connection enabled from now on.

The connection is local to this Mac only.

From your next login onward RTL Fixer attaches on its own. Reopening {0} from the Dock during a session starts it without the connection, so that session still needs a relaunch.

Set this up?

Done. {0} shortcut(s) updated.

Next time you start {1} it will connect on its own.
persistent.doneMac: Done. {0} will connect on its own from your next login.
persistent.removed: Removed. {0} is back to its original settings.
persistent.skipped: {0} system-wide shortcut(s) were left untouched — they need administrator rights.
persistent.failed:
Could not update the shortcuts for {0} ({1}).

Nothing was changed.
persistent.noShortcut:
No shortcut for {0} was found in your Start menu, Desktop or taskbar, so there is nothing to set up.

Pin the app first, then try again.
persistent.packaged:
{0} is installed from the Microsoft Store (an MSIX package), and Windows starts those through package activation rather than from a shortcut. There is no shortcut carrying settings for this app, so automatic connection cannot be set up.

{0} still works normally: it just needs "Relaunch with RTL Fix" once per session.
